thread:
nina: Quick heads up — listing stuck because partner's PO pays to "Vertex Hardware Ltd" but their marketplace vendor record is "Vertex Hardware, Inc". Portal rejected the PO with error: "vendor name mismatch". They attached a redlined agreement that flips back our warranty limitation. Need legal + finance input.

sam-partnerships: They pasted the portal error screenshot and a note that procurement payroll is frozen until end of quarter. They asked if we can accept a credit memo instead.

marco-legal: Send redline. If warranty cap was reinstated we need to push for original language. We can offer a narrow warranty for hardware defects tied to the certified image only.

alia-sales: Partner says reissuing PO will take 5+ business days. They asked if we can create a marketplace alias mapping. Partner claims we've done that for others.

ravi-finance: Alias mapping is possible but requires Kansas tax ID confirmation and partner-signed affidavit. Also marketplace ops needs a ticket from vendor to verify bank account. That adds 2-4 business days.

nina: Partner is on a promo timeline and wants to go live this Friday. Any fast routes?

marco-legal: Two pragmatic routes: (A) ask partner exec to authorize a one-off PO reissue with canonical vendor name and expedite via procurement lead, (B) accept a conditional pilot agreement with limited warranty reinstated for listing only, plus a scavenger clause referencing the final MSA to be signed later. I'll draft the pilot addendum.

sam-partnerships: I'll open a support escalation with marketplace team. Ticket 689001 opened, ETA 72h.

infra-bot: Created internal incident: marketplace-po-name-mismatch-INC-5507, assigned to partnerships and finance.

alia-sales: I'm escalating to partner VP to push procurement. Also asking for a scanned director-signed affidavit in case we need alias.

nina: Thanks — please attach affidavit here if they can sign. Marco, will you drop a short pilot addendum draft we can present to partner?

marco-legal: Yes. Drafting a 1-page addendum that limits warranty and delays general MSA finalization until settlement. Will post in 1hr.

ravi-finance: If we go pilot + affidavit, finance can provisionally approve net-30 settlement once affidavit and signed addendum are in place.

sam-partnerships: Recap: 1) Alia escalate with partner VP for PO reissue, 2) Marco draft pilot addendum to limit warranty exposure, 3) Nina collect affidavit if partner can sign, 4) Sam escalate support ticket with marketplace for alias mapping as fallback.

nina: Great—thanks everyone. I'll update when partner responds. :thumbsup:
